name: sound-board
description: Plays a distinct sound for subagent spawn/finish/failure, permission asks, auto-mode denials, finished turns and more; pick, preview and mute per cue

volume.title: Volume %
volume.description: 0-200; 100 is the file's own level (engine player and mp3 on Windows)

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.description: HH:MM-HH:MM local time, may cross midnight (22:00-08:00); empty = none

minTurnSeconds.title: Turn-done threshold (s)
minTurnSeconds.description: Only chime when a main turn took at least this long; 0 = every answer

speak.title: Speak agent results
speak.description: Also say 'agent done: <description>' when an agent finishes or fails

cooldownMs.title: Cooldown (ms)
cooldownMs.description: One sound per cue within this window, so a burst of spawns plays once

player.title: Player
player.description: auto: PowerShell on Windows, the engine elsewhere

subagentScope.title: Subagent cues for
subagentScope.description: all: every subagent, nested included. top: only agents the main thread started

askVia.title: Permission cue source
askVia.description: dialog: when a permission dialog is shown to you. check: whenever the engine's verdict is ask (noisy in auto mode)

longToolSeconds.title: Long command (s)
longToolSeconds.description: Cue when a Bash/PowerShell call ran at least this long; 0 = off
